# Version 4.150.2
> **Ganesh stability updates** · Released August 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.2) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.2/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.2/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.2 incorporates four upstream m150 synchronization rounds, including targeted Ganesh stability fixes. The updates prevent stale GPU readbacks and improve cleanup when a Ganesh resolve task cannot execute.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Four m150 engine fix rounds integrated** — Updates the release line through four upstream sync rounds, including targeted Ganesh work that prevents stale readbacks and unwinds failed resolve tasks. ([#4663](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4663), [#4648](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4648), [#4561](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4561), [#4517](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4517))
